parameters.content:
# Media recovery with manual approval

Pending drafts use their saved revision and edited project fields. Recovery only adds missing media; it never publishes. Covers are saved before screenshots, and retries reuse generated covers. Media failures return to the batch loop and remain visible in execution results. Candidate order rotates hourly to prevent failed projects starving the queue.

Deploy the media recovery API first. Configure Gemini quota, Browserless Query Auth (token), and public Blob storage before enabling image switches. No pipelineVersion change is needed when enabling media.

Keep one scheduler active; avoid overlapping manual runs.

## Media limits

At most three projects per run. Missing live URLs cannot be captured. Images must be under 4 MB.

Completed media is reused. A provider failure before the cover is saved may incur generation charges again. Missing media is retried when its feature switch is enabled.

Pending dashboard edits take priority over newer repository metadata until review. Media recovery rejects stale revisions and changed live URLs.
